definitions.explanation: An organized arrangement of people standing or moving in orderly lines, especially in military or ceremonial contexts.

examples.japanese: {隊列|たいれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{隊列|たいれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The children were walking in a line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{整然|せいぜん}とした→整然とする：23003_seizentosuru⟧{隊列|たいれつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{横切|よこぎ}った→横切る：02326_yokogiru⟧。
examples.english: The soldiers crossed the square in orderly formation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ (group, squad) + ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ (row, line). Implies organized, purposeful arrangement of people in lines or columns, carrying a sense of order and discipline.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隊列|たいれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to form a line/formation
- {隊列|たいれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a formation
- {隊列|たいれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乱|みだ}す→乱す：11412_midasu⟧: to break formation; to disrupt the ranks
- {隊列|たいれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to straighten the formation
- {隊列|たいれつ}⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧: marching in formation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧: line; queue; procession — a general word for people lined up, often waiting. {隊列|たいれつ} implies more military discipline and organization.
- ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧: row; line — the most basic word for a line of people or things. {隊列|たいれつ} specifically implies a group moving or standing in organized formation.
- {縦隊|じゅうたい}: column (military) — a specific formation type where people are lined up front to back.
